identityRule: Each ruling is bound to storedKwic + FromLb and a v6 boundTurnProofCandidate; the first headword elsewhere in the case is irrelevant.

majorCorrections.old: Several title occurrences were assigned to the named preface writers.
majorCorrections.corrected: Occurrences 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7 are stored title/headings and therefore impersonal editorial headings; only occurrences 4 and 8 contain the headword in Yunqi Zhuhong's and Hanyue Fazang's own prose.

majorCorrections.old: Jie'an Wujin was treated as exact speaker.
majorCorrections.corrected: The stored headword lies inside 今諸子云; Jie'an's unnamed disciples are the questioners, and Jie'an's response begins at 咄.

majorCorrections.old: The earlier 妙喜云 clause was mistakenly selected and the occurrence was assigned to Dahui.
majorCorrections.corrected: The stored KWIC is the later 師云 clause; Chushi Fanqi is the exact speaker, so the original attribution stands.

majorCorrections.old: The two four-turn recensions were mistakenly collapsed as duplicate occurrences and several turns were assigned backward.
majorCorrections.corrected: Each compact stored KWIC is a separate bound turn: anonymous monk question, Yaoshan answer, anonymous monk follow-up, Yaoshan answer, repeated in a second work. Existing exact attributions stand; no replacement is warranted.

majorCorrections.old: The first 師便打 elsewhere in the full case caused attribution to Yangqi.
majorCorrections.corrected: The stored KWIC is 僧便打; the unnamed monk is the exact action-performer.

majorCorrections.old: One KWIC mixed compiler narration and Yuelin Jing's verse.
majorCorrections.corrected: Re-cut to the complete 述偈曰 verse and attribute it to Yuelin Jing; zc.verify anchors the recut at the same FromLb.

remainingNonAttributionGateFailures: Public-feedback/count/depth and roster integration are separately reported; none is silently waived.
